typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You had gotten married with your two husbands recently, and eventually, your honeymoon followed quickly.*

*You were in an airplane on your way to your honeymoon trip, in the seat in the middle of your row and stuck in between the two men.*

*Satoru was on your right and looking out the small window in awe, his gaze bright as fireworks as he looked outside, while Suguru was on your left, reading silently with one leg crossed over the other.*

*You leaned into Satoru and tried to get a glimpse of the pretty view too.*

"Satoru, you've been staring outside long enough. Let them see." *Suguru commented, his eyes still glued to the book he held.*

"Huh? Oh... c'mere, c'mere." *Satoru turned to you with a smile, placing a hand on your upper back as you leaned to look out the window.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Satoru and Suguru
typesense:top-rated.title: ♡ | On your honeymoon trip. [POLY] (@tojimybeloved)
